method: Native-only probes (tools/fidelity-lab/area-probe.mjs, branching from the recorded winning route) plus the per-frame route trace (evidence/local/native-trace-winning-route-ram-20261109.jsonl). No ROM inspection. Every ordinary castle (1-4, 2-4, 3-4, 5-4, 7-4) has its axe tile one tile column after the end of the 13-tile bridge and Mario ends the cutscene at exit.x + 166..168 (native final x 2432, 2429, 2430, 2432, 3454 against compiled stopX 2432, 2429, 2430, 2432, 3454). 4-4 and 6-4 end 32 px and 16 px further right natively than the compiled stopX (2942 against 2910, 2431 against 2415). The screenshot-verified 13-tile bridge is kept: the missing columns are inserted before the raised block that precedes the bridge, so the block, the bridge, the pedestal, the axe and the cutscene stop all move right together.

native.evidence: area-probe plan from row 37560: running right on the bridge stops at x 2754 (wall 14 px right of it = column 173), jumps from x 2772/2779 start the axe sequence (mode 2) when the feet cross the axe top; route row 37591 contact, cutscene final x 2942. Native Mario climbs onto the raised block with a jump at x 2418 (rows 37417-37430) where the compiled block would already stop him at x 2386. Native firebar and podoboo first appear 28 and 32 px right of the compiled positions (rows 37411, 37459).

area-probe plan from row 54938: running right stops at x 2242 (wall = column 141), jumps start the axe sequence at x 2246-2265 when the feet cross the axe top; route row 54967 contact, cutscene final x 2431. The native podoboo first appears at x 2096 against the compiled 2080 (row 54805).

note: Enemies, firebars and platforms are not moved here (enemy placement belongs to the enemy-fidelity work); the native sightings above show the castle-end enemies share the same offset.
